summary: Completed comprehensive testing of STRENGTHENED secret atmosphere feature on mobile (390x844). All core requirements verified: prominent button positioning above grid, strong secret atmosphere with ambience layer, per-tile transformations with no black videos, revert functionality, mobile quality (no overflow/scroll blocking), sound toggle, and clear visual difference between public/secret modes. Tested on both francesca-rossi and vanessa-neri models. Regression tests confirm home page, admin login, and Campagne page still functional.
passed_tests: Backend API: /api/models/{slug}/segreto returns 3 images + 2 videos for all tested models
PROMINENT BUTTON: Secret trigger button positioned ABOVE media grid, visible without scrolling on 390x844
STRONG SECRET ATMOSPHERE: theme-secret class added, secret-ambience layer present with 3 blobs + 2 beams + grain
PER-TILE TRANSFORM: All 5 tiles transform correctly with staggered delays, no black/empty video tiles
REVERT: Revert button removes theme-secret class and secret-ambience layer, returns to public mode
MOBILE QUALITY: No horizontal overflow, vertical scrolling works in both modes, no JS errors
SOUND TOGGLE: Works without errors (audio not asserted per requirements)
CLEAR DIFFERENCE: Screenshots show dramatic visual difference - secret mode is darker/warmer with purple-bordeaux glow and glowing tile borders
REGRESSION: Home page model grid works with all 4 filters (tutte/nuove/piu-viste/in-tendenza)
REGRESSION: Admin login successful with provided credentials
REGRESSION: Admin Campagne page loads correctly
Tested on multiple models: francesca-rossi and vanessa-neri both pass all tests
